hook: *2,000* EWS flats approved only for auto-rickshaw workers
hook_b: *2,000* EWS flats approved only for auto-rickshaw workers
tldr: A government order on Friday cleared 2,000 Economically Weaker Section houses for auto-rickshaw workers: 500 each at Bandlaguda (LIG Colony, Nagole), Gandamguda, Petbasheerbad and Jalpally or Laxmiguda.

beats.what: The State Housing Board will use Indiramma Indlu eligibility, reservations and allotment rules, with the condition that beneficiaries are auto-rickshaw workers.
beats.why: The scheme copies the affordable flats at Indiramma Housing towers in the Core Urban Region Economy (CURE), per The Hindu.
beats.care: The Board must first verify land, site suitability and technical feasibility and file detailed project reports, so no allotment dates are out yet.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: G.O. issued November 13, 2026: 500 flats at each of four sites.

cards.q: Housing reserved for one profession: your take?
opts: Should be open to all EWS

qs: How will auto-rickshaw workers prove eligibility?
Will the four sites be close to where drivers work?

facts.t: Indicative project cost for the scheme is *₹22 crore*, per the G.O.

learn.t: EWS = Economically Weaker Section, the lowest income band for housing schemes.

watch: The Housing Board's project reports and when applications open.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana approves 2,000 affordable houses for auto-rickshaw workers in & around Hyderabad

fact: Telangana approves *2,000* flats for auto-rickshaw workers across four Hyderabad-area sites.
twist: The colonies will be named *'Auto Nagar Colony'* and follow Indiramma Indlu rules, with an indicative cost of *₹22 crore*.
